title: The Forbidden Experiment
summary: Deep beneath Incheon Subsea Tunnel Shaft 4, Ha-Jun discovers Dr. Vance attempting to open the Grand Void Gate using a synthetic replica of Tae-Jun's heart core.

panels.shot: abandoned incheon subsea rail tunnel in pitch blackness
panels.action: A massive circular concrete railway tunnel stretches into endless darkness under the Yellow Sea, sea water leaking from overhead seams.
panels.prose_en: A massive circular concrete railway tunnel stretches into endless darkness under the Yellow Sea, sea water leaking from overhead seams.
panels.prose_hi: Ek vishal golakar concrete railway surang peele sagar ke neeche antaheen andhere mein faili hui hai, jiske upar samudra ka pani ris raha hai.

panels.shot: distant hum of void energy vibrating through railroad tracks
panels.action: The steel train tracks hum and vibrate with electric purple resonance; miniature violet sparks dance across the rails.
panels.prose_en: The steel train tracks hum and vibrate with electric purple resonance; miniature violet sparks dance across the rails.
panels.prose_hi: Stil train ki patriyan vidyut baingani pratidhvani ke saath gungunati aur kampan karti han; laghu baingani chingari rail patriyon par nritya karti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun, baek, and min-jae jogging down the tunnel with flashlights
panels.action: The trio sprints along the maintenance catwalk; Ha-Jun's eyes illuminate the path ahead in soft violet light.
panels.prose_en: The trio sprints along the maintenance catwalk; Ha-Jun's eyes illuminate the path ahead in soft violet light.
panels.prose_hi: Teenon rakhrakhav catwalk ke saath daudte han; ha-jun ki aankhen naram baingani roshni mein aage ka rasta roshan karti han.

panels.shot: kuro flapping ahead sensing dimensional distortion
panels.action: Kuro glides ahead: 'The spatial fabric is paper-thin here. A massive dimensional gate is actively drawing power.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Spatial distortion critical hai. Wo log portal ko forcefully tear kar rahe hain.

panels.prose_en: Kuro glides ahead: 'The spatial fabric is paper-thin here. A massive dimensional gate is actively drawing power.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro aage badhta hai: 'yahan sthanik kapda kagaz jitna patla hai. ek vishal aayami gate sakriya roop se shakti khinch raha hai.'

panels.shot: opening into colossal underground subterranean cavern under the seabed
panels.action: The rail tunnel opens into a gargantuan subterranean chamber carved directly into sea bedrock, 200 feet high.
panels.prose_en: The rail tunnel opens into a gargantuan subterranean chamber carved directly into sea bedrock, 200 feet high.
panels.prose_hi: Rel surang 200 feet oonche samudra tal mein khude hue ek vishal bhumigat kaksh mein khulti hai.

panels.shot: in center: titanic 80-foot void gate framed by obsidian pillars
panels.action: In the cavern center stands an eighty-foot archway of black volcanic stone, covered in writhing tentacles and glowing magenta runes.
panels.prose_en: In the cavern center stands an eighty-foot archway of black volcanic stone, covered in writhing tentacles and glowing magenta runes.
panels.prose_hi: Gufa ke kendra mein kale jwalamukhiya patthar ka assi foot ka torandwar khada hai, jo tedhe-medhe tentekals aur chamakte magenta runon se dhaka hua hai.

panels.shot: vance standing on elevated control platform in exosuit
panels.action: On a suspended steel platform stands Dr. Victor Vance—now encased in an eight-foot heavy titanium combat exosuit.

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: You are too late, boy! The catalyst is already synchronizing!

panels.prose_en: On a suspended steel platform stands Dr. Victor Vance—now encased in an eight-foot heavy titanium combat exosuit.
panels.prose_hi: Ek nilambit steel platform par do. victor vens khade hain - jo ab aath foot bhari titanium combat exosuit mein lipte hue han.

panels.shot: floating in the center of the gate: glowing synthetic heart core
panels.action: Suspended in magnetic confinement rings at the gate's center: an artificial beating heart glowing with pulsating cyan and crimson blood.

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: A cloned organ cultured from your brother's marrow! The perfect key!

panels.prose_en: Suspended in magnetic confinement rings at the gate's center: an artificial beating heart glowing with pulsating cyan and crimson blood.
panels.prose_hi: Gate ke kendra mein chumbkiya karawas ke chhalle mein nilambit: ek kritrim dhadkata hua dil jo spandit siyan aur lal rang ke rakt se chamak raha hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes widening in horror seeing his brother's blood desecrated
panels.action: Ha-Jun stares at the suspended heart; its rhythmic beat resonates painfully in his own chest.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun hyung ke DNA se banaya gaya nakli heart... How dare they?!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stares at the suspended heart; its rhythmic beat resonates painfully in his own chest.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun nilambit hriday ko ghurta hai; iski laybaddh thap uske hi seene mein dard bhari goonjati hai.

panels.shot: fifty void cultists and cyber-hunters aiming rifles down from gantries
panels.action: Across the metal catwalks above, fifty heavily armed cultists and cybernetic mercenaries cock weapons simultaneously.
panels.prose_en: Across the metal catwalks above, fifty heavily armed cultists and cybernetic mercenaries cock weapons simultaneously.
panels.prose_hi: Upar dhatu catwalk ke par, pachas bhari hathiyaron se lais panthvadi aur cybernetic bhaade ke sainik ek saath hathiyar uthate han.

panels.shot: baek and min-jae taking cover behind concrete rail bumpers
panels.action: Baek and Min-Jae dive behind heavy concrete rail stops: 'Ha-Jun! We will suppress the catwalks! You take Vance!'

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Min-Jae, left flank! Ha-Jun, don't let that gate fully open!

panels.prose_en: Baek and Min-Jae dive behind heavy concrete rail stops: 'Ha-Jun! We will suppress the catwalks! You take Vance!'.
panels.prose_hi: Bek aur min-je bhari concrete rail stop ke peeche gota lagate han: 'ha-jun! hum catwalk daba denge! aap vens ko le lijiye!'

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping into the open ignoring the storm of bullets
panels.action: Ha-Jun walks into the hail of machine-gun fire; a three-inch violet mana barrier deflects every single bullet effortlessly.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun walks into the hail of machine-gun fire; a three-inch violet mana barrier deflects every single bullet effortlessly.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun mashin-banduk ki aag ke beech chalta hai; teen inch ka baingani maina barrier har ek goli ko aasani se vikshepit kar deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun summoning bone of the forgotten into left hand
panels.action: The ancient Bone of the Forgotten relic materializes in Ha-Jun's left hand, transforming into a 10-foot skeletal scythe.
panels.prose_en: The ancient Bone of the Forgotten relic materializes in Ha-Jun's left hand, transforming into a 10-foot skeletal scythe.
panels.prose_hi: Bhule hue avashesh ki prachin haddi ha-jun ke baen haath mein bhautik ho jaati hai, jo 10 foot ke kankal ki hansiya mein badal jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun swinging bone scythe in a 360-degree horizontal wave
panels.action: Ha-Jun sweeps the scythe horizontally; a 100-foot crescent shockwave of spectral white bone blades sweeps through the gantries.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sweeps the scythe horizontally; a 100-foot crescent shockwave of spectral white bone blades sweeps through the gantries.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun daraanti ko kshaitij roop se ghumata hai; varnakramiy safed haddi ke blade ki 100 foot ki ardhchandrakar shockwev gantry ke madhyam se bahti hai.

panels.shot: all gantry supports sheared cleanly collapsing into the chasm
panels.action: The steel support pillars are severed like toothpicks; gantries, cultists, and catwalks collapse in an avalanche of twisted metal.
panels.prose_en: The steel support pillars are severed like toothpicks; gantries, cultists, and catwalks collapse in an avalanche of twisted metal.
panels.prose_hi: Stil ke samarthan khambhe tothpix ki tarah kate hue han; gaintri, kaltist aur catwalk mudi hui dhatu ke himskhalan mein dhah jaate han.

panels.shot: vance launching from platform with rocket thrusters
panels.action: Vance ignites plasma thrusters on his exosuit's back, rocketing straight down toward Ha-Jun with a heavy hydraulic pile-bunker.

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: DIE LIKE YOUR PARENTS, KANG HA-JUN!!

panels.prose_en: Vance ignites plasma thrusters on his exosuit's back, rocketing straight down toward Ha-Jun with a heavy hydraulic pile-bunker.
panels.prose_hi: Vens apne exosuit ki peeth par plasma thrusters ko prajvalit karta hai, ek bhari hydraulic pil-bankar ke saath sidhe ha-jun ki or rocket karta hai.

panels.shot: vance pile-bunker slamming down into ha-jun raised palm
panels.action: Vance's five-ton hydraulic fist smashes down—and is caught cold in the palm of Ha-Jun's bare right hand.
panels.prose_en: Vance's five-ton hydraulic fist smashes down—and is caught cold in the palm of Ha-Jun's bare right hand.
panels.prose_hi: Vence ki paanch ton ki hydraulic mutthi tutkar gir jaati hai aur ha-jun ke nange dahine haath ki hatheli mein thandi pad jaati hai.

panels.shot: vance exosuit alarms screaming: 'MAXIMUM TORQUE INSUFFICIENT'
panels.action: Inside Vance's cockpit, red emergency warnings flash: 'Hydraulic arm integrity 12%... Target's grip exceeding 800 metric tons!'

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: Impossible! My suit has the strength of a hydraulic press!

panels.prose_en: Inside Vance's cockpit, red emergency warnings flash: 'Hydraulic arm integrity 12%... Target's grip exceeding 800 metric tons!'.
panels.prose_hi: Vence ke cockpit ke ander, lal aapatkalin chetavani flash hoti hai: 'hydrolik baanh ki akhandata 12%... lakshya ki pakad 800 metric ton se adhik!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun crushing the titanium pile-bunker into twisted scrap
panels.action: Ha-Jun's fingers squeeze; the reinforced tungsten-titanium fist folds, groans, and implodes like an empty soda can.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's fingers squeeze; the reinforced tungsten-titanium fist folds, groans, and implodes like an empty soda can.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki ungaliyan sikud gain; prabalit tangston-titenium mutthi ek khali soda can ki tarah mudati hai, karahati hai aur fat jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun driving a knee strike into vance chest armor
panels.action: Ha-Jun drives a mana-charged knee strike into the exosuit's chestplate, blowing the heavy armor plating out its back.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun drives a mana-charged knee strike into the exosuit's chestplate, blowing the heavy armor plating out its back.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun exosuit ke chestaplate mein ek mana-charj ghutne ka prahar karta hai, jisse uski peeth par chadha hua bhari kavach ​​ud jata hai.

panels.shot: vance flying backward 100 feet crashing into gate pedestal
panels.action: The shattered exosuit skids across the stone floor, slamming violently into the obsidian base of the Void Gate.
panels.prose_en: The shattered exosuit skids across the stone floor, slamming violently into the obsidian base of the Void Gate.
panels.prose_hi: Tuta hua exosuit patthar ke farsh par fisalta hua, void gate ke obsidian base se jordar tarike se takraya.

panels.shot: vance cockpit ejecting revealing bloody, broken old man
panels.action: The damaged cockpit pops open; Dr. Vance crawls out onto his knees, bleeding profusely from his nose and mouth.

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: You... You are not human... You are a monster...

panels.prose_en: The damaged cockpit pops open; Dr. Vance crawls out onto his knees, bleeding profusely from his nose and mouth.
panels.prose_hi: Kshatigrast cockpit khul jata hai; do. vens apne ghutnon ke bal rengte hue bahar nikalte han, unki naak aur munh se bahut adhik khoon bah raha hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing over vance looking down with cold eyes
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands over the broken scientist, his silhouette framed by the swirling purple vortex of the gate behind him.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Maine kabhi nahi kaha main insaan hoon. I am the Demon Sovereign.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands over the broken scientist, his silhouette framed by the swirling purple vortex of the gate behind him.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun toote hue vaigyanik ke upar khada hai, uska chhayachitra uske peeche gate ke ghumte baingani bhanwar se bana hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up at the floating synthetic heart
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks up at the artificial heart; its erratic pulse is destabilizing the gate, causing sea water to flood through the ceiling.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks up at the artificial heart; its erratic pulse is destabilizing the gate, causing sea water to flood through the ceiling.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun kritrim hriday ki or dekhta hai; iski aniyamit gati gate ko asthir kar rahi hai, jisse samudra ka pani chhat se hokar bah raha hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping up and gently cupping the synthetic heart
panels.action: Ha-Jun leaps forty feet into the air, cradling the synthetic heart in both hands with brotherly tenderness.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Rest now. You don't have to suffer anymore.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun leaps forty feet into the air, cradling the synthetic heart in both hands with brotherly tenderness.
panels.prose_hi: Bhaichare ki komalta ke saath synthetic dil ko donon hathon mein pakadkar ha-jun chalis feet hawa mein uchhalta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun channeling his pure sovereign mana into the heart
panels.action: Golden and violet sovereign mana washes over the synthetic heart, soothing its torment and turning its black miasma into clean starlight.
panels.prose_en: Golden and violet sovereign mana washes over the synthetic heart, soothing its torment and turning its black miasma into clean starlight.
panels.prose_hi: Sunahra aur baingani samprabhu man kritrim hriday par chha jata hai, uski peeda ko shant karta hai aur uske kale mayasma ko swachh taron ki roshni mein badal deta hai.

panels.shot: the synthetic heart dissolving into peaceful golden embers
panels.action: The artificial heart peacefully dissolves into thousands of golden light particles, sinking into Ha-Jun's chest.
panels.prose_en: The artificial heart peacefully dissolves into thousands of golden light particles, sinking into Ha-Jun's chest.
panels.prose_hi: Kritrim hriday shantipurvak hajaron sunhare prakash kanon mein vilin ho jata hai, ha-jun ki chhati mein doob jata hai.

panels.shot: the void gate roaring as its catalyst is removed
panels.action: Without the catalyst, the Void Gate begins to violently convulse, sucking surrounding rubble into its dimensional core.
panels.prose_en: Without the catalyst, the Void Gate begins to violently convulse, sucking surrounding rubble into its dimensional core.
panels.prose_hi: Utprerak ke bina, shunya gate hinsak roop se ainthane lagta hai, aaspaas ke malbe ko apne aayami core mein sokh leta hai.

panels.shot: vance screaming as the vortex pulls him toward the abyss
panels.action: Vance screams as the gravitational pull drags him into the event horizon: 'No! The void will devour me!'

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: SAVE ME, SOVEREIGN! DON'T LET THEM CONSUME ME!!

panels.prose_en: Vance screams as the gravitational pull drags him into the event horizon: 'No! The void will devour me!'.
panels.prose_hi: Vence chillata hai kyonki gurutvakarshan khinchav use ghatna kshitij mein khinchta hai: 'nahin! shunya mujhe kha jaega!'

panels.shot: vance vanishing into the void as ha-jun turns away cliffhanger
panels.action: Vance vanishes into the pitch-black abyss; Ha-Jun turns his back calmly as the vortex opens a stable dimensional wormhole to Tartarus.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Portal stable ho chuka hai. The path to Tartarus is open.

panels.prose_en: Vance vanishes into the pitch-black abyss; Ha-Jun turns his back calmly as the vortex opens a stable dimensional wormhole to Tartarus.
panels.prose_hi: Vence ghor kali khai mein gayab ho jata hai; jaise hi bhanwar tarters ke liye ek sthir aayami varmahol kholta hai, ha-jun shanti se apni peeth ghumata hai.
